segments.contextAfter: `denyDLC` ([string]): An array of StorNext volume names. If the Xsan client is attempting to mount a volume named in this array, the client only mounts the volume if its logical units (LUNs) are available through Fibre Channel. It doesn’t attempt to mount the volume using Distributed LAN Client (DLC).

It doesn’t attempt to mount the volume using Distributed LAN Client (DLC).

segments.contextAfter: `denyMount` ([string]): An array of Xsan or StorNext volume names. If no `onlyMount` array is present, the Xsan client automatically attempts to mount all SAN volumes except the volumes in this array. The system administrator can mount those volumes manually by using the `xsanctl(8)` mount command.
